title: 1621 gives fresh, youthful flavor to novelty dance hit "Pamela"
summary: Next gen P-pop group 1621 gives the infectious and distinctly Pinoy song “Pamela” a fresh spin, adding their vibrant group harmonies and energetic new dance moves.
